articles.summary: Treatment adherence is crucial in achieving positive outcomes, yet despite its importance, non-adherence to prescribed treatments is a significant issue. Collaborative Care Management (CoCM) has emerged as a key solution to improving adherence rates, leveraging integrated approaches and advanced technologies to support patients more effectively. This blog explores how Collaborative Care Management models measure and enhance treatment adherence and provides recent, credible statistical data to support their impact.
articles.title: Improving Treatment Adherence Through Collaborative Care Management

articles.summary: The healthcare landscape is marked by a complex web of specialized care, often leading to fragmented patient experiences. Siloed care, where each provider (especially physical and mental health) is treated as a separate entity, can hinder positive patient outcomes. This is particularly evident in the management of chronic conditions, where behavioral factors significantly impact treatment adherence and overall well-being. Integrated behavioral health and chronic condition management offer a transformative approach, fostering a holistic view of the patient and driving improved health outcomes.
articles.title: Breaking Down Silos: The Power of Integrated Behavioral Health and Chronic Condition Management
